summary: controller profile with jog, pad, fader, eq, audio, usb diagnostic groups. Companion workflow(s): Serato DJ Pro.
identityNotes: Research seed. The DDJ-REV5 DRI1872B manual confirms USB MIDI control (p. 132), nominal 48 kHz Audio Section sampling and 24-bit A/D and D/A converters (p. 133). USB audio stream formats and channel counts, DIN MIDI, USB IDs, class compliance, hardware/firmware revision applicability, receiving/Identity support, exact control maps, OS/software qualification and factory tolerance limits remain unverified. See docs/devices/pioneer-dj-ddj-rev5.md.

documents.title: DDJ-REV5 Operating Instructions (DRI1872B)
documents.notes: DRI1872B p. 132: MIDI DJ-software control over USB; p. 133: nominal Audio Section sampling and A/D,D/A converter depth; p. 134: two USB Type-C terminals. USB audio stream formats/channel counts and receiving/Identity support are not established. See docs/devices/pioneer-dj-ddj-rev5.md.

specs.label: USB MIDI control transport
specs.notes: DRI1872B p. 132: connecting a PC/Mac with MIDI software via USB enables control of other DJ software; some buttons depend on the application. This establishes USB MIDI control, not DIN transport, receiving/Identity support or an exact control map.

specs.label: Nominal audio-section sampling rate
specs.notes: DRI1872B p. 133, Audio Section: nominal sampling rate is 48 kHz. This does not enumerate supported USB stream sample rates or USB channel counts.

specs.label: Audio-section A/D and D/A converter depth
specs.notes: DRI1872B p. 133, Audio Section: A/D and D/A converters are 24 bit. Converter resolution does not establish USB stream word length; connectivity.audio.bitDepth remains unknown.

tests.title: Jog rotation and touch
tests.why: Check jog function on DDJ-REV5; avoid assumptions about HID or analog routing.
steps: Consult the exact DDJ-REV5 manual for the relevant connectors and operating mode.
Exercise each jog element on the device and observe MIDI, HID/software response or audio measurement as applicable.
Check slow and fast transitions, all channels/sides, and repeats; save raw evidence and mark unobservable functions as not tested.
equipment: Compatible host software or capture interface when required
